svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="5FjHfVwnqJAkIjETGL8z"> <mxGraphModel dx="2778" dy="1326" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor User as User
 participant UI as User Interface
 participant ctrl as Control
 participant db as Database

 %% 核心流 %%
 User->>UI: 1. searchAddress(address)
 activate UI
 UI->>ctrl: 1.1 requestAddressData(address)
 activate ctrl

 ctrl->>db: 1.2 checkAddressValidity(address)
 activate db
 db-->>ctrl: validity result
 deactivate db

 alt Address Invalid
 ctrl-->>UI: return Error
 UI->>User: 1.3 display \"Address not found\"
 else Address Valid
 ctrl->>db: 1.4 checkFutureDataAvailability()
 activate db
 db-->>ctrl: availability result
 deactivate db
 
 alt Data Unavailable
 ctrl->>db: 1.5 fetchData()
 activate db
 db-->>ctrl: historical raw data
 deactivate db
 ctrl->>ctrl: 1.6 analysisUsingHistoryAndCurrentData()
 ctrl-->>UI: return Fallback Data
 UI->>User: 1.7 display current data map
 else Data Available
 ctrl->>ctrl: 1.8 predict(gridBlock)
 ctrl->>ctrl: 1.9 shapAttribution(gridBlock)
 ctrl->>ctrl: 1.10 exceedsWHOThreshold()
 ctrl->>ctrl: 1.11 getDominantSource()
 ctrl-->>UI: initial map data ready
 UI->>User: 1.12 display Initial Prediction Map
 end
 end
 deactivate ctrl

 %% 交互 1 %%
 User->>UI: 2. select grid block
 UI->>ctrl: 2.1 getLatestPrediction()
 activate ctrl
 ctrl->>ctrl: 2.2 getConfidenceScore()
 ctrl-->>UI: returns prediction details
 deactivate ctrl
 UI->>User: 2.3 display detailed view

 opt Set Floor Level
 User->>UI: 2.4 setFloorLevel(floorLevel)
 UI->>ctrl: 2.5 getAdjustedDBLevel(floorLevel)
 activate ctrl
 ctrl-->>UI: returns adjusted dB
 deactivate ctrl
 UI->>User: 2.6 update detailed view
 end

 opt Set Noise Tolerance
 User->>UI: 2.7 setNoiseTolerance(noiseTolerance)
 UI->>UI: 2.8 update detailed view based on tolerance
 end

 %% 交互 2 %%
 opt Lease Calculator
 User->>UI: 3. input moveInDate & duration
 UI->>ctrl: 3.1 estimateFinancialImpact()
 activate ctrl
 
 ctrl->>db: 3.2 getOverlapWithLease(startDate, endDate)
 activate db
 db-->>ctrl: permit records
 deactivate db
 
 ctrl->>ctrl: 3.3 isActive()
 ctrl->>ctrl: 3.4 isUpcoming()
 ctrl->>ctrl: 3.5 isExpired()
 ctrl->>ctrl: 3.6 getNoisyMonths()
 
 ctrl-->>UI: returns financialImpactRange
 deactivate ctrl
 UI->>User: 3.7 display financial impact & noisy months
 end

 %% 交互 3 %%
 opt Compare Locations
 User->>UI: 4. compareNeighbourhoods(addressB)
 UI->>ctrl: 4.1 requestComparison(addressB)
 activate ctrl
 ctrl->>db: 4.2 fetchData(addressB)
 activate db
 db-->>ctrl: block B data
 deactivate db
 ctrl-->>UI: returns comparison metrics
 deactivate ctrl
 UI->>User: 4.3 display side-by-side comparison
 end

 %% 交互 4 %%
 opt Share Prediction
 User->>UI: 5. sharePrediction()
 UI->>User: 5.1 display share success/link
 end
 deactivate UI",
 "config": null
